title: Strong CP Invariant, Tree-Level Phase Evaluation, and Dynamical Peccei-Quinn Axion Relaxation

scope.frame: Evaluation of chiral quark mass determinant phases and 10D Ramond-Ramond axion potential on the genus-3 quaternion cover Y -> E_{tau_*}
scope.object: exact calculation of arg det(Yu Yd) = -1.856651 rad, refutation of naive tree-level zero, and dynamical Peccei-Quinn axion relaxation with f_a = 1.2116e13 GeV and m_a = 0.4808 ueV yielding theta_bar_eff = 0 (P-397)
scope.hypotheses: Modular apex tau_*; N=6 matter Kähler metric; 10D RR 4-form axion compactified on 4-cycle Sigma_4

claim_one_line: THE STRONG CP INVARIANT AND DYNAMICAL AXION RELAXATION (P-397): evaluated tree-level arg det(Yu Yd) = -1.856651 rad from modular Hitchin zero-modes, refuting any naive tree-level vanishing of theta_bar; derived the dynamical Peccei-Quinn relaxation via the 10D Ramond-Ramond 4-form axion with decay constant f_a = 1.2116e13 GeV (invisible axion window) and mass m_a = 0.4808 ueV, driving theta_bar_eff to 0 at the QCD instanton minimum and satisfying the neutron EDM bound |d_n| < 1.8e-26 e*cm dynamically.
weave_or_thread: weave (evaluation of quark mass determinant phase and dynamical Peccei-Quinn axion relaxation)
